units.name: 9 我明天上午在学校学习

sents.en: Hello!
Hello, everyone!
Hello, teacher!
Hello, all!
Thank you!
You're welcome!
Goodbye, class!
Goodbye, teacher!
May I ask, what's your name?
My name is Chen Tianzhong.

sents.zh: 你好，陈天中！我不是安妮，我是白家月。
sents.en: Hello, Chen Tianzhong! I'm not Annie—I'm Bai Jiayue.
sents.spokenZh: 你好，陈天中！我不是安妮，我是白家月。

sents.en: Sorry!
It's okay!
Hello! My name is Li Wen.
Hello! My name is Bai Jiayue.
Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too.
I'm Chinese.

sents.zh: 我是法国人。我的中文老师也是中国人。
sents.en: I'm French. My Chinese language teacher is also Chinese.
sents.spokenZh: 我是法国人。我的中文老师也是中国人。

sents.en: Who is this?
This is my girlfriend.
What nationality is your girlfriend?
She is also Thai.
Hi!
Sister!
Are you still busy with work?
Yes, I'm still very busy. Are you busy too?
I'm not too busy. We miss you a lot.
I miss you all too.
Is Yifei busy?
She is very busy.
How many students does she have?
She has twenty students.
I have two elder brothers. How about you?
I don't have any elder brothers.
How many people are there in your family?

sents.zh: 我家有四口人，爸爸、妈妈、妹妹和我。
sents.en: There are four people in my family: my dad, my mom, my younger sister, and me.
sents.spokenZh: 我家有四口人，爸爸、妈妈、妹妹和我。

sents.en: Is this your son?

sents.zh: 是的。我有两个孩子，一个儿子，一个女儿。
sents.en: Yes. I have two children, a son and a daughter.
sents.spokenZh: 是的。我有两个孩子，一个儿子，一个女儿。

sents.en: How old is your son?
He is five years old.
How old is your daughter?
She is twelve.
What's the date today?
It's September 8.
What day is it today?
It's Sunday. I'm off today.
Do you know how to cook?
Yes, I do.
What dishes can you make?

sents.zh: 我会做面条儿、饺子，也会做一些菜。星期天我也做饭。
sents.en: I can make noodles, jiaozi, and some other dishes. I also cook on Sundays.
sents.spokenZh: 我会做面条儿、饺子，也会做一些菜。星期天我也做饭。

sents.en: Are you off work?
Yes, I am.
Is this your new computer?
Yes, it's my new computer.
It looks really nice!
I really like it too.
What's your cell phone number?
My cell phone number is +33 601493190.
My cell phone number is +86 13552721160.
Alright.
Where are you going tomorrow?
I want to go to the supermarket to buy groceries.
What are you going to buy at the supermarket?
I want to buy some milk.

sents.zh: 星期天我们去哪儿吃晚饭？
sents.en: Where are we going for dinner on Sunday?
sents.spokenZh: 星期天我们去哪儿吃晚饭？

sents.en: I'd like to go to Xi'an Restaurant again.

sents.zh: 那边的包子非常好吃，我想吃包子。
sents.en: The steamed stuffed buns there are very delicious—I'd love to eat some.
sents.spokenZh: 那边的包子非常好吃，我想吃包子。

sents.zh: 妈妈，我想吃米饭，不想吃包子。
sents.en: Mom, I'd rather have rice—not steamed stuffed buns.
sents.spokenZh: 妈妈，我想吃米饭，不想吃包子。

sents.en: Alright. How shall we get there?
Let's take a taxi.
What time is it now?
It's 8:40 in the morning.
I have a class at 10:10 in the morning.

sents.zh: 好的，我们下午两点见吧。
sents.en: Alright, let's meet at 2:00 in the afternoon.
sents.spokenZh: 好的，我们下午两点见吧。

sents.zh: 下午我想去电影院看电影，你去吗？
sents.en: I want to go to the cinema to watch a movie this afternoon. Are you going?
sents.spokenZh: 下午我想去电影院看电影，你去吗？

sents.en: I don't want to go. I still have something to do this afternoon.
Okay. How about tomorrow?

sents.zh: 我明天下午两点还上课呢，四点半下课。
sents.en: I have a class tomorrow afternoon at 2:00 and it finishes at 4:30.
sents.spokenZh: 我明天下午两点还上课呢，四点半下课。

sents.en: Hey, where are you?
I'm at home.
I'll finish work at 6:30 in the evening.
I'll go to work at the hospital at 8:00.

sents.zh: 好的，你去店里买些菜吧。
sents.en: Alright, could you go to the store to buy some vegetables?
sents.spokenZh: 好的，你去店里买些菜吧。

sents.en: Okay, I'll go in ten minutes.
There is a little cat outside the room.
I don't see it. Where is it?
It's under the table.
This little cat is so beautiful!
Where shall we meet?
Let's meet in front of the school bookstore.

sents.zh: 好的。下午两点你能到吗？
sents.en: Okay. Can you arrive at 2:00 in the afternoon?
sents.spokenZh: 好的。下午两点你能到吗？

sents.zh: 我能到。我在学校吃午饭。
sents.en: Yes, I can. I'll have lunch at school.
sents.spokenZh: 我能到。我在学校吃午饭。

sents.en: Haven't you eaten yet?
No, I haven't.

sents.zh: 大医院病人多，医生非常忙。
sents.en: There are a lot of patients in big hospitals, and doctors are very busy.
sents.spokenZh: 大医院病人多，医生非常忙。

sents.zh: 是的。我爸爸也在医院工作，他也非常忙。
sents.en: True. My father also works at a hospital, and he's extremely busy too.
sents.spokenZh: 是的。我爸爸也在医院工作，他也非常忙。

sents.en: So there are two doctors in your family?
Yes.

sents.zh: 学校前边有一家电影院。
sents.en: There is a cinema in front of the school.
sents.spokenZh: 学校前边有一家电影院。

sents.zh: 对。我们晚上去那个电影院看电影吧。
sents.en: Yes. Let's go to the cinema to watch a movie tonight.
sents.spokenZh: 对。我们晚上去那个电影院看电影吧。

sents.zh: 好！我们七点在电影院外边见，好吗？
sents.en: Great! Let's meet outside the cinema at 7:00, okay?
sents.spokenZh: 好！我们七点在电影院外边见，好吗？

sents.en: Okay, see you at 7:00 in the evening!

sents.zh: 椅子上有一本中文书，那是谁的书？
sents.en: There is a Chinese book on the chair. Whose book is that?
sents.spokenZh: 椅子上有一本中文书，那是谁的书？

sents.zh: 是我的书，谢谢。这是我的第二本中文书。
sents.en: It's my book, thanks. This is my second Chinese book.
sents.spokenZh: 是我的书，谢谢。这是我的第二本中文书。

sents.zh: 不客气。你明天上午在哪儿？
sents.en: You're welcome. Where will you be tomorrow morning?
sents.spokenZh: 不客气。你明天上午在哪儿？

sents.zh: 我明天上午在学校学习。
sents.en: I'll be studying at school tomorrow morning.
sents.spokenZh: 我明天上午在学校学习。

sents.en: Tomorrow is Saturday. What are you going to do?

sents.zh: 我白天在家里读书，晚上和朋友们去外边唱歌。
sents.en: I will read at home during the day and go out to sing with my friends in the evening.
sents.spokenZh: 我白天在家里读书，晚上和朋友们去外边唱歌。

sents.en: You sing very well.
Thank you! What will you do on Saturday?

sents.zh: 我在家里做饭、看电视，和孩子们、小狗玩。
sents.en: I will cook, watch TV, and play with my children and my little dog at home.
sents.spokenZh: 我在家里做饭、看电视，和孩子们、小狗玩。

sents.en: I also have a little dog.
Excuse me, do you have any cups?
Yes, the cups are over here.
How much is one?

sents.zh: 这些五块钱一个，那些十块钱一个。
sents.en: These are five yuan each, and those are ten yuan each.
sents.spokenZh: 这些五块钱一个，那些十块钱一个。

sents.en: I'll take this one, please.
There's so much fruit here!
What would you like to buy?
I'd like two jin of apples, please.

sents.zh: 苹果三块五一斤。这些七块二，七块钱吧。
sents.en: The apples are 3.5 yuan per jin. That's 7.2 yuan in total—let's round it down to 7 yuan.
sents.spokenZh: 苹果三块五一斤。这些七块二，七块钱吧。

sents.zh: 好的，这儿的苹果真便宜！
sents.en: Great! The apples here are really affordable!
sents.spokenZh: 好的，这儿的苹果真便宜！

sents.zh: 这家商店衣服真多！这件一百元，怎么样？
sents.en: There are so many clothes in this store! This one is 100 yuan. What do you think?
sents.spokenZh: 这家商店衣服真多！这件一百元，怎么样？

sents.en: It looks great, and it's not expensive.
Xiaoxue can wear it. Let's get one.
Okay. Do you think Xiaoming can wear it too?

sents.zh: 不能。这些是女孩子穿的衣服，男孩子的衣服在那儿。
sents.en: No. These are girls' clothes. The boys' section is over there.
sents.spokenZh: 不能。这些是女孩子穿的衣服，男孩子的衣服在那儿。

sents.en: When will you arrive at the restaurant?

sents.zh: 还不知道，正在找呢。它是不是在超市后边？
sents.en: Not sure yet. I'm looking for it now. Is it behind the supermarket?
sents.spokenZh: 还不知道，正在找呢。它是不是在超市后边？

sents.en: Yes, it is. Are you driving or not?
No, I'm not driving. I'm taking a taxi.
Are you still studying at university?

sents.zh: 对，我读大学呢，还是大学生。
sents.en: Yes. I'm studying at university, and I'm still an undergraduate.
sents.spokenZh: 对，我读大学呢，还是大学生。

sents.en: Are you busy with your studies?

sents.zh: 非常忙，我学医，我们的课很多。
sents.en: Very busy. I major in medicine, and we have a lot of classes.
sents.spokenZh: 非常忙，我学医，我们的课很多。

sents.en: Has the younger brother gotten up yet?
Not yet. He's still sleeping.

sents.zh: 还睡呢？他今天去不去那里？
sents.en: Still sleeping? Is he going there today?
sents.spokenZh: 还睡呢？他今天去不去那里？

sents.en: Going where?
To the supermarket.

sents.zh: 我昨天问他，他对我说，他不去，他今天要和小朋友玩。
sents.en: I asked him yesterday. He told me he's not going—he wants to play with his friends today.
sents.spokenZh: 我昨天问他，他对我说，他不去，他今天要和小朋友玩。

sents.en: How's the weather today?

sents.zh: 这里的天不太好，下雨了。
sents.en: It's not great here. It's raining.
sents.spokenZh: 这里的天不太好，下雨了。

sents.en: Is it raining heavily?
A bit, and I feel really cold.
It snowed yesterday.
Yes, it's too cold.

sents.zh: 你昨天没来公司，生病了？
sents.en: You didn't come to the company yesterday. Were you sick?
sents.spokenZh: 你昨天没来公司，生病了？

sents.zh: 对，我昨天去医院看病了。
sents.en: Yes, I went to the hospital to see a doctor yesterday.
sents.spokenZh: 对，我昨天去医院看病了。

sents.en: Doctor, I'm not feeling well.
Let me take a look. How are you feeling?
I feel very cold.

sents.zh: 好的，吃一点儿药，今天休息半天吧。
sents.en: Alright. Take some medicine and rest for half a day today.
sents.spokenZh: 好的，吃一点儿药，今天休息半天吧。

sents.en: Make sure to drink some warm water after you get home.

sents.zh: 我可以再问您一个问题吗？
sents.en: May I ask you one more question?
sents.spokenZh: 我可以再问您一个问题吗？

sents.en: Yes, of course. What's your question?
Does that small shop sell cell phones?

sents.zh: 我不知道。你可以打电话问一下。
sents.en: I'm not sure. You can call to ask.
sents.spokenZh: 我不知道。你可以打电话问一下。

sents.en: Madam, have a seat, please! What would you like to drink?

sents.zh: 我看一下。请给我一杯牛奶。
sents.en: Let me have a look. I'll have a glass of milk, please.
sents.spokenZh: 我看一下。请给我一杯牛奶。

sents.en: Alright. Would you like anything else?

sents.zh: 我还没吃早饭，再要这个面包和鸡蛋吧。
sents.en: I haven't had breakfast yet, so I'll have a fried egg on bread.
sents.spokenZh: 我还没吃早饭，再要这个面包和鸡蛋吧。

sents.en: Sir, have a seat, please! What would you like to order?
I'd like one jin of jiaozi.
Alright. One jin of jiaozi has forty pieces.

sents.zh: 四十个太多了，我要一半吧。
sents.en: Forty is too many. I'll have half of that.
sents.spokenZh: 四十个太多了，我要一半吧。

sents.zh: 半斤二十个。您想喝什么？
sents.en: Half is twenty. What would you like to drink?
sents.spokenZh: 半斤二十个。您想喝什么？

sents.en: I'll have a cup of tea, please.

sents.zh: 你们上火车后看见王老师了吗？
sents.en: Did you see Ms. Wang after boarding the train?
sents.spokenZh: 你们上火车后看见王老师了吗？

sents.zh: 没看见。中午车开后，有些人在看书，有些人睡觉了。
sents.en: No, we didn't. After the train departed at noon, some people were reading, while others fell asleep.
sents.spokenZh: 没看见。中午车开后，有些人在看书，有些人睡觉了。

sents.en: What about you?
I watched a movie.

sents.zh: 你们会说汉语了，也会写汉字了吗？
sents.en: You can speak Chinese now. Can you also write Chinese characters?
sents.spokenZh: 你们会说汉语了，也会写汉字了吗？

sents.en: We can all write them now.
Teacher, I can't hear you.

sents.zh: 请大家不要说话！请听老师的问题：你们都会写哪些汉字了？
sents.en: Everyone, please stop talking! Listen to my question: Which Chinese characters can you write?
sents.spokenZh: 请大家不要说话！请听老师的问题：你们都会写哪些汉字了？

sents.en: I can write these characters. Look!
Our daughter will start middle school next year.
That's right. Our son will also start primary school.

sents.zh: 我们家有了一个中学生。
sents.en: We will have a middle school student in our family.
sents.spokenZh: 我们家有了一个中学生。

sents.en: And a primary school student.
Once they start school, they will both be busy.
Yes. It's too late. Let's go to bed.
Which dish do you like?

sents.zh: 我喜欢这个，也喜欢那个。
sents.en: I like this one, and that one too.
sents.spokenZh: 我喜欢这个，也喜欢那个。

sents.zh: 这些菜都好吃，还很好看。
sents.en: These dishes are all delicious, and they look great too.
sents.spokenZh: 这些菜都好吃，还很好看。

sents.zh: 我爱吃中国菜，也喜欢做。大家多吃点儿。
sents.en: I love eating Chinese food, and I also enjoy cooking it. Everyone, eat more!
sents.spokenZh: 我爱吃中国菜，也喜欢做。大家多吃点儿。

sents.en: Where do you all want to go?

sents.zh: 去年我和男朋友去了西安，今年我想去北京。
sents.en: My boyfriend and I went to Xi'an last year, and I want to visit Beijing this year.
sents.spokenZh: 去年我和男朋友去了西安，今年我想去北京。

sents.zh: 前几年我去了西安，非常好玩儿。今年我也想去北京。
sents.en: I went to Xi'an a few years ago, and it was really fun. This year, I want to go to Beijing too.
sents.spokenZh: 前几年我去了西安，非常好玩儿。今年我也想去北京。

sents.zh: 我和王老师都是北京人，北京非常漂亮。
sents.en: Ms. Wang and I are both from Beijing. Beijing is very beautiful.
sents.spokenZh: 我和王老师都是北京人，北京非常漂亮。

sents.zh: 你们的飞机到北京要几个小时？
sents.en: How many hours will your flight take to get to Beijing?
sents.spokenZh: 你们的飞机到北京要几个小时？

sents.en: Nine hours.

sents.zh: 我家人都在北京，星期天我姐姐也有时间，她可以去机场接你们，你们也可以住我家。
sents.en: My whole family lives in Beijing. My sister will be free on Sunday. She can pick you up at the airport, and you can stay at my home.
sents.spokenZh: 我家人都在北京，星期天我姐姐也有时间，她可以去机场接你们，你们也可以住我家。

sents.zh: 我们星期日早上八点到大兴机场，早不早？
sents.en: We'll arrive at Daxing Airport at 8:00 on Sunday morning. Is that early?
sents.spokenZh: 我们星期日早上八点到大兴机场，早不早？

sents.en: Not early at all.

sents.zh: 谢谢老师！那我们和您姐姐在大兴机场见！
sents.en: Thank you, teacher! Then we'll meet your sister at Daxing Airport!
sents.spokenZh: 谢谢老师！那我们和您姐姐在大兴机场见！
